definitions.median: Middle observed value, or arithmetic mean of the two middle values for even n.
definitions.model_seconds: Saved model-response elapsed time on the local monotonic clock, including failed requests. Not server-only inference time.
definitions.p95: Nearest-rank empirical percentile: sorted nonmissing observations at one-based rank ceil(0.95*n). No interpolation.
definitions.pipeline_seconds: Saved local total_seconds for each method execution, including provider, parsing/extraction and applicable solver work. Excludes evaluator/reference solving and campaign downtime; not campaign wall time.
definitions.solver_seconds: Local solve invocation elapsed time for B, conditional on reaching the solver. Includes local preprocessing; not CP-SAT search time alone. A has no solver observations.
definitions.timing_comparability: Aggregate times mix recorded OS/concurrency phases; zero cases have all four model/method observations under matching OS/concurrency. Descriptive operational observations, not a controlled speed ranking.
definitions.total_tokens: Provider-reported prompt plus completion tokens per scheduling attempt; missing usage remains unknown. Capability calls excluded; observed failures with usage would be included.
definitions.worked_case: Selected explanatory case, not a representative sample. Saved provider content is final output, not hidden reasoning. Clock labels are deterministic conversions of original slots.
